name: rustiron_vein
description: front view of a low craggy boulder of dark grey stone split by thick veins of rusty red iron ore, a few red-brown ore nuggets at its foot, orthographic 3/4 top-down RPG prop, facing the camera

name: sunstone_vein
description: front view of a low sandstone boulder with glowing amber-gold crystals of sunstone growing out of its cracks, orthographic 3/4 top-down RPG prop, facing the camera, on sand

name: ashglass_vein
description: front view of a low jagged outcrop of glossy black volcanic glass with thin glowing orange ember veins, dusted with pale grey ash, orthographic 3/4 top-down RPG prop, facing the camera

name: bogiron_vein
description: front view of a low mossy lump of dark boggy stone studded with knobbly black-brown iron nodules, wet green moss and a little mud at its base, orthographic 3/4 top-down RPG prop, facing the camera

name: dune_ribs
description: front view of the giant sun-bleached ribcage of a long-dead dinosaur half buried in pale desert sand, a row of big curved ribs arching up out of the sand, orthographic 3/4 top-down RPG prop, facing the camera

name: dune_skull
description: front view of the huge sun-bleached skull of a long-dead dinosaur half sunk in pale desert sand, empty eye socket and long jaw of big teeth, orthographic 3/4 top-down RPG prop, facing the camera

name: hitching_post
description: front view of a sturdy wooden hitching post: a thick upright log with a crossbar and an iron ring, a coil of rope hanging from it, orthographic 3/4 top-down RPG prop, facing the camera

name: big_gate
description: front view of a wide closed wooden pen gate for large animals: two tall double doors of heavy lashed logs between two thick posts, orthographic 3/4 top-down RPG prop, facing the camera

name: big_gate_open
description: front view of a wide wooden pen gate for large animals standing open: two thick upright posts with a log lintel across the top and the heavy log doors swung open against the posts, an empty gap between them, orthographic 3/4 top-down RPG prop, facing the camera

name: skyfang_spire
description: front view of a tall jagged spire of glowing blue-white crystal bursting up out of cracked earth, sharp shards splintering off it, faint light inside, orthographic 3/4 top-down RPG prop, facing the camera

name: meteor_rock
description: front view of a small smoking meteorite rock lying in a shallow scorched crater, black pitted stone with glowing red-orange cracks, orthographic 3/4 top-down RPG prop, facing the camera
